name: manual_113e9d
claim: gbrain multi-source drift occurs when pages exist at 'default' source but should be at intended source (e.g., intended=gstack-code-XXX). Doctor reports: '2487 page slugs appear at default but NOT intended'. Root cause: pre-v0.30.3 putPage misroutes OR source never completed initial sync. Fix: re-sync with 'gbrain sync --source <id> --full' or delete misrouted page with 'gbrain delete <slug>'. gbrain team planning 'gbrain sources rehome' cleanup command (v0.32.0+).

decisions.notes: Session 2026-07-04 doctor output showed multi-source drift for 2487 pages. Drift is not critical (both locations are indexed) but indicates stale federated state. Clearing old sync state and reimporting resolved most. Drift can accumulate over time if sources aren't re-synced—monitor with 'gbrain doctor' periodically.
